data.name: MYTH - Make Your True Hero -
data.detailed_description:
Make Your True Hero is a fantasy open-world MMORPG designed to revive the true essence of classic MMOs while delivering a modern, flexible, and immersive experience.

Powered by a proprietary high-performance engine, the game supports a massive number of players simultaneously, creating a living world where exploration, progression, and PvP feel truly alive.

Choose your path, define your combat style, master multiple lineages, and forge your legend in a universe shaped by ancient gods.

A TRUE OPEN MMORPG EXPERIENCE

Explore a vast world filled with forests, frozen mountains, deserts, oceans, cities, and mythological kingdoms. A dynamic day and night cycle changes not only the atmosphere, but also creatures, NPC behavior, and available activities.

• Massive open world
• Dynamic day & night system
• PvE, PvP, professions, exploration, and social systems
• Designed for large-scale multiplayer interactions

PROGRESSION BEYOND COMBAT — THE SKILL TREE

In the world of Make Your True Hero, you don’t need to fight to grow stronger.

Progress by practicing what you love and contribute to your overall Adventurer Level through the Skill Tree System. With eight distinct branches — Adventurer Level, Ranking, Blacksmithing, Farming, Professions, Lineage Mastery, Weapon Mastery, and Armor Mastery — you have full control over your character’s attributes, progression, and gathering capabilities.

Advance in a non-linear way through seven stages of growth, starting as a simple Recruit and rising to become the True Hero.

Your journey. Your choices. Your evolution.

FLEXIBLE PROGRESSION – PLAY YOUR WAY

Progression in Make Your True Hero is fully flexible. You are not forced into PvP or constant combat to evolve.

Advance through the activities you enjoy most:
• Combat
• Professions
• Exploration
• Quests
• Social and economic gameplay

Your hero grows according to your choices — not rigid paths.

FOUR CLASSES – MULTIPLE COMBAT LINEAGES

Each class features three unique combat lineages, directly linked to the weapon you equip. Changing weapons instantly changes your abilities and playstyle.

You can eventually learn all three lineages of your class, allowing deep customization and strategic flexibility.

⚔ Warrior

Frontline fighters focused on physical combat and resilience.
• Paladin (Sword & Shield) – Defense and counterattacks
• Lancer (Spear) – Versatile melee and magic hybrid
• Templar (Greatsword) – Slow but devastating power

🔮 Mage

Masters of arcane forces and battlefield control.
• Sorceress (Staff) – Elemental AoE destruction
• Priestess (Scepter & Shield) – Healing and support
• Archmage (Grimoire) – Dark magic, curses, and debuffs

🛡 Guardian

High resistance warriors who combine durability and damage.
• Barbarian (Dual Axes) – Aggressive sustained melee
• Sentinel (Throwing Weapon & Shield) – Defensive ranged combat
• Reaper (Scythe) – Dark damage over time and life drain

🗡 Rogue

Agile and lethal specialists of speed and precision.
• Archer (Bow) – Long-range damage
• Assassin (Claws) – Fast close combat
• Duelist (Dual Daggers) – Stealth, poisons, and attrition

WEAPON-BASED LINEAGE SYSTEM

Your equipped weapon defines your active lineage.
Switching weapons instantly unlocks a new skill set and disables the previous one, preventing buff stacking and keeping combat balanced.

This allows dynamic gameplay where players adapt in real time to different encounters and strategies.

ARMOR SYSTEM – BUILD YOUR PLAYSTYLE

• Light Armor – High mobility and damage
• Balanced Armor – Versatility
• Heavy Armor – Maximum defense and tanking

Your armor choice directly impacts combat efficiency, survivability, and mobility.

MOUNTS & PETS

Mounts and pets are not just cosmetic — they are active companions.

Mounts

• Ground, aquatic, and flying mounts
• Combat while mounted
• Special abilities, storage, and evolution system

Pets

• Combat companions
• Support and gathering assistants
• Fully customizable appearances
• Loyalty and affinity progression

PROFESSIONS & PLAYER-DRIVEN ECONOMY

Specialize in gathering and crafting professions such as:
• Lumberjack
• Miner
• Collector
• Skinner
• Fisherman
• Builder

Resources fuel the economy, crafting, construction, and trade between players, creating a living and interdependent world.

KINGDOMS OF MYTH

Ally yourself with one of four great kingdoms, each inspired by ancient mythologies and ruled by a sovereign god:

• Celtic – Sucellus, Goddess of Nature
• Greek – Zeus, God of Thunder
• Egyptian – Ra, God of the Sun
• Norse – Odin, God of Wisdom and War

Each kingdom influences the world’s culture, aesthetics, and identity.

DYNAMIC DAY & NIGHT CYCLE

The world completes six full day/night cycles every 24 real hours.

• Day: Safer exploration, active NPCs, diurnal creatures
• Sunset: Environmental changes and emerging dangers
• Night: Deadly monsters, special encounters, rare events
• Dawn: World resets and opportunities renew

The cycle directly impacts gameplay, atmosphere, and strategy.

A WORLD FORGED BY GODS

The story unites Greek, Norse, Celtic, and Egyptian mythologies in a single original universe. The gods Zeus, Odin, Ra, and Sucellus battle over Eldran, the Primordial Planet — a source of near-infinite power.

Humanity rises between divine conflicts, shaping the fate of a fragile world where balance is constantly threatened.

FAIR MONETIZATION

• Optional Premium subscription (also purchasable with in-game currency)
• Cash shop focused on cosmetics
• No pay-to-win
• Quality-of-life benefits only

The competitive balance is preserved for all players.

data.short_description: Make Your True Hero is a fantasy open-world MMORPG featuring flexible progression, dynamic PvP, weapon-based combat lineages, mounts, professions, and a living world shaped by mythological gods.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel/AMD x64 bit Processor from 2016 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 GPU from 2018+ with at least 2GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel/AMD x64 bit Processor from 2018 or greater
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 GPU from 2020+ with at least 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
